mapper.select: SELECT #{userId} AS user_id, (SELECT u.balance FROM users u WHERE u.id = #{userId}) + COALESCE(SUM(p.quantity * s.current_price), 0) AS total_assets, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(p.quantity * p.average_price), 0) > 0 THEN (SUM(p.quantity * s.current_price) - SUM(p.quantity * p.average_price)) * 100.0 / SUM(p.quantity * p.average_price) ELSE 0 END AS total_return_rate FROM portfolios p JOIN stocks s ON p.stock_id = s.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT s.code AS stock_code, s.name AS stock_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_buy_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sell_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.quantity ELSE -t.quantity END), 0) AS net_quantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sell_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.total_amount ELSE -t.total_amount END), 0) AS net_amount FROM transactions t JOIN stocks s ON t.stock_id = s.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY s.code, s.name ORDER BY s.code

SELECT CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE) AS trade_date, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buy_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sell_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'BUY' THEN t.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buy_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'SELL' THEN t.total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sell_amount, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM transactions t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY CAST(t.transaction_date AS DATE) ORDER BY trade_date DESC
